note: San Saba County (unincorporated) publishes no zoning layer; Texas counties generally do not zone. City of San Saba has a zoning ordinance (ecode360 Art. III) whose official zoning map is kept on file with the City Secretary, not published as any ArcGIS/WFS/download service. ArcGIS search for San Saba zoning found only a parcel layer with empty zoning fields. Richland Springs found no zoning publication.
